usedBytes.description: Represents the total number of bytes currently in use.

capacityBytes.description: Represents the total storage capacity in bytes.

title:
StorageStats provides an abstraction for storage metrics of a disk associated with a directory.
It offers key insights into the disk's total capacity, current storage usage, and available space.
The total capacity is a fixed value, while the available space is dynamically calculated.
Additionally, it can determine whether a specified amount of data can fit within the remaining available space.
name: StorageStats
